messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick sync — aiming to announce Optimize v2 tomorrow at noon PT. Need final changelog line, docs URL, and rollout timing.

Ilya (eng): Plan: canary 08:30 PT (5%), demo pinned to variant `optimize-v2-demo` at 09:45 PT for webinar, promote to 100% by 11:45 PT if green. Adding rollback note to changelog.

Emily (docs): I'll publish final docs and redirect by 15:00 PT today. Need the CLI screenshot; can grab after canary verification.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need benchmark hero sentence for the post (latency @4k and token cost). Ilya?

Ilya (eng): Use: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context; ~30% token cost reduction with batching + quantization." Pushing a short blurb to the changelog now.

Marta (mktg): Thanks. Alerting: page #eng-oncall if error rate > 1% during rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Ilya at 2026-03-29T08:30:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Ilya (eng): Canary live. Health checks green — demo variant pinned.

Marta (mktg): Final doc link when ready and we'll lock publish at 12:00 PT.

Emily (docs): Docs live: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2. Redirect in place.

Ilya (eng): Promotion to 100% complete at 11:46 PT. No elevated errors.

Marta (mktg): Launch live. Updating press kit and post-rollout checklist now.
